question: busiest pickup zones weekday rush hour jan 2024 top 5
sql: WITH rush AS (SELECT PULocationID, fare_amount, trip_distance, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hr, EXTRACT(DOW FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS dow FROM nyc_taxi_trips WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-02-01' AND fare_amount > 0 AND trip_distance > 0), zone_stats AS (SELECT PULocationID, list(fare_amount) AS fares, list(trip_distance) AS dists, COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM rush WHERE dow BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND hr IN (8, 9, 17, 18) GROUP BY PULocationID) SELECT PULocationID AS pickup_zone_id, trip_count, len(list_filter(fares, x -> x > 30)) AS premium_trips, (list_sum(dists) / len(dists)) AS avg_distance FROM zone_stats ORDER BY trip_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: hourly trip counts avg median fare distribution jan 2024
sql: WITH hourly_lists AS (SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hr, list(fare_amount) AS fare_list FROM nyc_taxi_trips WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-02-01' AND fare_amount > 0 AND fare_amount < 500 AND trip_distance > 0 AND trip_distance < 100 GROUP BY hr), expanded AS (SELECT hr, UNNEST(fare_list) AS fare FROM hourly_lists) SELECT hr, COUNT(*) AS trips, AVG(fare) AS avg_fare, MEDIAN(fare) AS median_fare, quantile_cont(fare, 0.9) AS p90_fare FROM expanded GROUP BY hr ORDER BY hr

question: zones most high fare trips over $100 jan 2024
sql: WITH zone_lists AS (SELECT PULocationID, list(fare_amount) AS fare_list FROM nyc_taxi_trips WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-02-01' AND fare_amount > 0 AND fare_amount < 500 GROUP BY PULocationID HAVING COUNT(*) > 100), high_fares AS (SELECT PULocationID, UNNEST(list_filter(fare_list, x -> x > 100)) AS high_fare FROM zone_lists) SELECT PULocationID AS pickup_zone_id, COUNT(*) AS high_fare_trips, AVG(high_fare) AS avg_high_fare FROM high_fares GROUP BY PULocationID ORDER BY high_fare_trips DESC LIMIT 5

question: long distance cheap trips fare per mile under $3.50 jan 2024
sql: WITH trips AS (SELECT STRUCT_PACK(pickup_zone := PULocationID, dropoff_zone := DOLocationID, dist := trip_distance, fare := fare_amount, ppm := CASE WHEN trip_distance > 0 THEN fare_amount / trip_distance ELSE NULL END) AS s FROM nyc_taxi_trips WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-02-01' AND trip_distance > 10 AND trip_distance < 100 AND fare_amount > 0 AND fare_amount < 500) SELECT s.pickup_zone AS pickup_zone, s.dropoff_zone AS dropoff_zone, s.dist AS distance_miles, s.fare AS fare_amount, s.ppm AS fare_per_mile FROM trips WHERE s.ppm < 3.5 ORDER BY s.dist DESC LIMIT 10

question: pickup vs dropoff imbalance ratio by zone jan 2024
sql: WITH all_zones AS (SELECT list(DISTINCT PULocationID) AS pickup_list, list(DISTINCT DOLocationID) AS dropoff_list FROM nyc_taxi_trips WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-02-01'), zone_union AS (SELECT DISTINCT UNNEST(list_concat(pickup_list, dropoff_list)) AS zone_id FROM all_zones), pickups AS (SELECT PULocationID AS zone_id, COUNT(*) AS pickup_cnt FROM nyc_taxi_trips WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-02-01' GROUP BY PULocationID), dropoffs AS (SELECT DOLocationID AS zone_id, COUNT(*) AS dropoff_cnt FROM nyc_taxi_trips WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-02-01' GROUP BY DOLocationID) SELECT z.zone_id, COALESCE(p.pickup_cnt, 0) AS pickups, COALESCE(d.dropoff_cnt, 0) AS dropoffs, ABS(COALESCE(p.pickup_cnt, 0) - COALESCE(d.dropoff_cnt, 0)) AS imbalance, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.dropoff_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(p.pickup_cnt, 0)::DOUBLE / d.dropoff_cnt ELSE NULL END AS pickup_dropoff_ratio FROM zone_union z LEFT JOIN pickups p ON z.zone_id = p.zone_id LEFT JOIN dropoffs d ON z.zone_id = d.zone_id ORDER BY imbalance DESC LIMIT 10

question: longest avg trip duration by pickup zone over 60 min count jan 2024
sql: WITH durations AS (SELECT STRUCT_PACK(zone := PULocationID, dur := date_diff('minute', tpep_pickup_datetime, tpep_dropoff_datetime), dist := trip_distance) AS s FROM nyc_taxi_trips WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-02-01' AND tpep_dropoff_datetime > tpep_pickup_datetime AND date_diff('minute', tpep_pickup_datetime, tpep_dropoff_datetime) BETWEEN 2 AND 180 AND trip_distance BETWEEN 0.5 AND 100), grouped AS (SELECT s.zone AS pickup_zone, list(s.dur) AS dur_list, list(s.dist) AS dist_list, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM durations GROUP BY s.zone HAVING COUNT(*) > 50) SELECT pickup_zone, trips, (list_sum(dur_list)::DOUBLE / len(dur_list)) AS avg_duration_min, (list_sum(dist_list) / len(dist_list)) AS avg_distance, len(list_filter(dur_list, x -> x > 60)) AS long_trips_over_60min FROM grouped ORDER BY avg_duration_min DESC LIMIT 10
